correctness.rationale: Stationary Poisson-redraw direction has E u²=1/d, E u⁴=3/(d(d+2)); generator L gives six triangular stationary fourth moments and a six-variable forward two-time hierarchy. Subtraction of reverse-lag E[x0^3 xs] yields exactly the stated e^-4s exponential polynomial F_d(s)/[15d²(d+2)] at r=gamma/a=2. The independent thermal OU component adds identical Wick cross terms to both fourth moments, hence cancels for all D>=0. Direct symbolic differentiation gives F(0)=F’(0)=F’’(0)=0,F’’’(0)=-18(d+3). H_d=e^-s F’’’ is affine in d and negative for d=1,7 and thus all 1..7. For d>=8 H_d’ is upward quadratic in exp(s) with one crossing on s>=0; successive integrations from zero show exactly one positive zero of F and hence the sign diagram. The general-r short-lag cubic and r>1 long-lag e^-s coefficients were reconstructed from the same triangular generator. No claim of uniqueness for general r or of a zero-mode asymptotic was made. The supplied independent numerical RK4 checks are consistency tests only.
residual_risks: Uniqueness requires exact gamma=2a, stationary initial process and complete isotropic redraw; general-r positive/negative coefficient cases are merely sufficient for at least one crossing.
